Grimes & Company Trimmed Its Stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) as Share Price Rose; As Goldcorp New (GG) Shares Declined, Kopernik Global Investors Lifted Stake 
February 22, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
David Iben increased its stake in Goldcorp Inc New (GG) by 54.41% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kopernik Global Investors Llc bought 419,770 shares as the company’s stock declined 20.41% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by David Iben held 1.19 million shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $15.44 million, up from 771,535 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kopernik Global Investors Llc who had been investing in Goldcorp Inc New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.07B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $12.91. About 2.65 million shares traded. Goldcorp Inc. (NYSE:GG) has declined 19.95% since February 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.65% the S&P500. 
Grimes & Company Inc decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc. (AAPL) by 2.84% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grimes & Company Inc sold 3,161 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 108,188 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $16.67 million, down from 111,349 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grimes & Company Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $876.51 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.98% or $1.675 during the last trading session, reaching $172.745. About 17.73M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since February 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Among 53 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 34 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Apple Inc. had 378 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Monday, November 20. UBS maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Tuesday, September 20 with “Buy” rating. Barclays Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Wednesday, August 2. Barclays Capital has “Equal-Weight” rating and $146 target. Cowen & Co maintained the stock with “Market Perform” rating in Monday, October 26 report. The company was maintained on Monday, August 7 by Drexel Hamilton. Goldman Sachs maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Wednesday, April 27 with “Buy” rating. As per Wednesday, April 27, the company rating was maintained by Pacific Crest. The company was downgraded on Friday, December 1 by Gabelli. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity with “Buy” on Monday, September 21. The rating was maintained by Drexel Hamilton with “Buy” on Friday, October 27. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.72 EPS, up 29.52% or $0.62 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.80 billion for 15.88 P/E if the $2.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.08% negative EPS growth.
